1990: Intact forest on 95 percent of the box; the Mega Rice Project canals are not yet dug (1996 to 1998). No FIRMS record before 2001
1995: Forest on 97 percent of the box; Mega Rice Project canal digging starts in 1996. No FIRMS record before 2001
2000: After the 1997 to 1998 El Nino fires: 93 percent forest, 7 percent degraded or regrowth. FIRMS record starts 2001
2005: Forest down to 82 percent, 15 percent degraded, 2.5 percent sparse; 949 FIRMS detections
2010: Wet year, 15 fire detections; Landsat cloud gaps (37 percent) filled from the 2005 and 2015 composites, 87 percent of the clear view is forest
2015: El Nino fires: 2,923 FIRMS detections; forest down to 74 percent of the box, 22 percent degraded
2020: Wet years: regrowth brings the forest class back to 92 percent; 15 FIRMS detections
2022: 94 percent forest class, 25 FIRMS detections; the quietest year in the FIRMS record
2023: El Nino returns: 970 FIRMS detections, forest class down to 82 percent, 3.8 percent sparse
2024: 86 percent forest, 11 percent degraded; 16 FIRMS detections; cumulative burn scar 1.2 percent of the box
2025: 82 percent forest, 14 percent degraded, 3.6 percent sparse; cumulative burn scar 1.4 percent of the box; no annual FIRMS file yet
2026: 80 percent forest, 16 percent degraded; 4,254 FIRMS detections in the box in the 7 days to 8 Oct 2026
